title: Crate Lift
reference: repeat 2 { F1 } def F1 { turn_left pick_up turn_right drop jump jump jump }
hints: Each ledge is two high. A crate makes it one step at a time.
F1: turn left, pick up the crate, turn back, drop it ahead, then jump twice. Main repeats F1.
